test_gateway_shutdown_cleans_cached_agen: test that gateway stop cleans up cached agents and calls shutdown_memory_provider on each
test_cache_cleared_after_gateway_stop: test that the agent cache dictionary is cleared after calling gateway stop
test_multiple_cached_agents_cleanup: test that all cached agents are cleaned up during gateway shutdown
test_cleanup_survives_agent_exception: test that an exception from one agent shutdown does not prevent other agents from being cleaned up
test_running_and_cached_agent_not_double: test that agents in both running and cached lists are cleaned at least once during shutdown
